external_sources.adaptation: Use existing Qt context-scoped singleShot to reveal the selected enemy body only on first construction.

decision: Adapt the established fixed-stage reader and Qt native navigation rather than add a second generic viewer. Existing source-qualified stage identity, map layers and history work together in the current Python/Qt host. Mature generic web viewers do not implement these game-reference contracts; no new framework is needed for this navigation and copy change.
